svg.title: spt command-line help
svg.text: ssh-perma-tunnel
PS> spt --help
Permanent SSH2/SSH3 tunnels with reconnect, observability, and service integration.
Usage: spt [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>
Commands:
config Manage configuration files (init, validate, diff, render, reload)
profile Manage SSH/SSH3 tunnel profiles
forward Manage forwards (local/remote TCP, UDP)
tunnel Run, inspect, and control tunnels
service Install and control native services
key Generate, inspect, and install SSH keys
secret Manage the secret vault and OS keychain references
auth Authentication helpers
dns Built-in DNS resolver and hosts-file management
firewall Inspect and manage OS firewall / packet-filter rules
log Log tailing, sink testing, and export
observe Metrics and Windows Event Log helpers
event Event bindings and sinks
stats Statistics summaries and live counters
session Inspect and manage active sessions
ftp FTP->SFTP translator service
sftp SFTP file operations and mount planning
diagnose Targeted diagnostics and support bundles
benchmark Controlled benchmarking against forwards
mcp Built-in MCP server controls
ssh3-serve Run the in-repo SSH3 (QUIC + HTTP/3) server end - the responder half of an spt<->spt
SSH3 tunnel
